_comment: PROTOCOL.md v1 §9.3 operating-point table. DATA, not code. Base constants are wfb_ng-derived seeds (docs/groundwork.md); Pass 111 hardware-calibrates the HT20/100-fps local-service ceilings for MCS4-7 on the SSC338Q craft. RE-DERIVE after a driver, framing/FEC, pacer, cadence, width, or hardware-class change (§17).
_table_version_note: table_version on the wire is a CRC-8 CONTENT HASH of this table's canonical serialization (§3.6), NOT this integer. This field is advisory/human only. 0x80 is this table's actual computed hash (pinned in tests/table_hash_test.cpp and tests/config_test.cpp). Moved from 0xBF by Pass 122 — the per-rung packet budgets are inside the hash, so changing them is a fleet-wide lockstep redeploy.

units.tx_power_level: PORTABLE power INTENT index (§10.2). NOT absolute. Each TX node resolves (adapter, mcs, level) -> an absolute qdb via that adapter's LOCAL power map. No regulatory clamp (§10.3).
units.airtime_budget_frac: fraction of wall-clock airtime this link may occupy
units.arq_deadline_ms: per importance class; iframe class longer (§4.1/§8)
units.fec_scheme: none in the base table; 'rlc256' / 'rlc256_iframe' / 'tetrys_reactive' only if §14 bench gate 2 justifies it
units.fec_overhead_frac: airtime/bitrate debited for parity (§14). MUST be > 0 wherever a stream runs fec_scheme rlc256 (§9.5 Pass 95) — §9.5 is the only place parity airtime is accounted. Graduated, monotonically non-increasing with rung index: r = ceil(k·rate) inflates as k falls and k falls with the rung (measured 8.8% of source at k~19, 29.1% at k~4). 0 when fec_scheme=none.

_per_adapter_power: Absolute per-MCS power is authored per physical adapter in a LOCAL file (PHY_REG_PG.txt row format, §10.2), e.g. profiles/power.<adapter>.txt — one per adapter (each has its own efuse cal/antenna). Node-local, operator-owned, not shipped here. Craft has one adapter; only ground has more.
_rungs_note: MCS 6-7 are normal high rungs the RSSI-margin promote can reach (§9.4). The wfb_ng 'reserved for probe' tag is dropped (Pass 163's probe rides the video stream in-band, no side stream).
_probe_note: §9.4 Pass 163 sequence-derived rate probe: video DATA frames with seq % period == slot fly the up-candidate MCS. Hashed into table_version (§3.6) — edit in lockstep fleet-wide. §17 seeds; period 0 disables. TX also needs air.mcs_probe (stage-0-proven units only). NOT DEPLOYED: the flying tables (craft + ground, 2026-08-20) carry no probe block at all, so probing is off by schedule as well as by knob, and that is why they hash to a different table_version than this file. Copying THIS file onto a node therefore switches the probe on as a side effect — edit the deployed copy instead. Before any rollout, re-derive period/slot and the window against our fps/block structure (§17 lists them as devourer/wfb_ng bench fits, not tuned values), confirm the craft's unit is stage-0-proven per-unit, and deploy to both ends in lockstep because the schedule is hashed.
